titles.title: Blue Nude (Leah)

credit_line: Sheldon Museum of Art, University of Nebraska–Lincoln, Gift of anonymous donor, U-4423.1991
description: Depicts Leah Harris, a food demonstrator in southwestern Texas, with whom O'Keeffe became friends in 1917. Minimalist forms come together to portray a woman with dark hair bending over. She stands on a surface denoted by a single curved line. The image contrasts with the plain white paper surrounding it.
